description: This file declares utility functions related to creating and managing WebRTC peer connections within the cuttlefish project. It provides function prototypes for creating threads, peer connection factories, and peer connections, encapsulated within the 'cuttlefish::webrtc_streaming' namespace.

methods.name: CreateAndStartThread
methods.description: Creates and starts a new RTC thread with the specified name, returning a Result containing a unique pointer to the thread.

methods.name: CreatePeerConnectionFactory
methods.description: Creates a WebRTC PeerConnectionFactory using specified network, worker, and signal threads, along with an audio device module. Returns a Result with a scoped reference pointer to the factory interface.

methods.name: CreatePeerConnection
methods.description: Creates a PeerConnection with the provided factory, dependencies, port range, and ICE servers. Returns a Result with a scoped reference pointer to the peer connection interface.
